title: Ligand-based discovery of coronavirus main protease inhibitors using MACAW molecular embeddings
summary: MACAW molecular embeddings and ligand-based models prioritized purchased compounds for assays. The paper reports inhibition of recombinant coronavirus main protease for eight of ten selected molecules; compound 7 also reduced hCoV-229E infectivity in a cell assay. This is not a clinical COVID-19 result or proof of SARS-CoV-2 patient benefit.
ai_technology: MACAW molecular embeddings used in ligand-based machine learning virtual screening
organization: Central South University; Université de Lorraine; University Hospital of Nancy; University of California, Santa Cruz

evidence.tested: Primary article reports 8/10 selected compounds inhibiting recombinant Mpro and follow-up cellular testing of compound 7 against HCoV-229E.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and exhaustive prior-art review are not established.
